review_notes: I read the whole file. I searched Mathlib for relativeSpec, pushforwardStructureAlgebra and AffineSchemeOver and found nothing, so the file's central constructions (relative Spec, function-algebra recovery, counit) have no Mathlib counterpart to compete with. The private charts functionChart and functionChartIso are built from Mathlib's IsAffineOpen.fromSpec, isoSpec and preimage. They reuse those declarations and do not re-implement them. relativeSpecFunctionsIso is a thin named wrapper around asIso, and its _hom and _inv lemmas are rfl lemmas. These are useful named API, not a competing concept. The relativeSpecCounit uses Mathlib's NatIso.ofComponents and MorphismProperty.Over.isoMk. I found no justified duplication finding. I did not check every upstream TauCeti definition in detail, only that the ones this file depends on are not in Mathlib.
